decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a low-cost variant close to the core offer, and demand for it is still uncertain after a 2023 launch, so keeping the option open is cheap.
The shower channel for seamless coverings has its own page, fits the barrier-free bathroom trend, and costs little to carry, so the option should stay open.
The pump-assisted solution extends the firm's capabilities and its market value has not yet resolved, which justifies keeping it despite somewhat higher carrying costs.
The tileable floor drain is close to the core business, has its own page, and keeping it costs little while its uptake is still being learned.
The stainless design grate fits the firm's design-led strategy and uses existing manufacturing, so its low carrying cost justifies keeping the option.
